data.title: Defiance Nasdaq 100 LightningSpread Income ETF (QLDY) Unveils Dividend Details for Q4: Mark Your Calendar!
data.description:
Defiance Nasdaq 100 LightningSpread Income ETF (NASDAQ: QLDY) has declared, under its dividend policy, a monthly cash dividend in the amount of $0.13 per common share. That signifies an annualized amount of $1.54 per share.

The dividend will be payable on 12/01/2026, to holders of record at the close of business on 11/30/2026.

QLDY has a dividend yield of 27.14%.

The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks current income and, secondarily, capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by employing a “LightningSpread” strategy, which is designed to generate daily income that the fund manager intends to distribute twice weekly. The fund’s strategy also seeks to provide long exposure to the price return of the Nasdaq 100 index (the “index”). The fund is non-diversified.
